episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Cory feels betrayed when his older brother takes a girlfriend to a ballgame instead of him.

episodes.name: On the Fence
episodes.overview: Cory paints shutters for Mr. Feeny raise money to buy an expensive squirt gun.

episodes.name: Father Knows Less
episodes.overview: The day after watching a late-night baseball game with his dad, Cory falls asleep in class and strikes out on a test.

episodes.name: Cory's Alternative Friends
episodes.overview: Cory has a hair-raising experience when he tries to straighten his curly top and ends up in exile eating lunch at the "weirdo" table at school.

episodes.name: Killer Bees
episodes.overview: When Cory learns that the geography-bee winner will get to be a batboy at the World Series, he maps out a plan to participate.

episodes.name: Boys II Mensa
episodes.overview: Cory cheats on an IQ test, and Mr. Feeny has the bright idea of sending him to a school for geniuses.

episodes.name: Grandma Was a Rolling Stone
episodes.overview: Grandma visits the Matthews' house and makes some big promises, including one to Cory she can't keep.

episodes.name: Teacher's Bet
episodes.overview: Under the impression that teaching is easier than learning, Cory ends up teaching social studies for a week as part of a bet with Mr. Feeny.

episodes.name: Class Pre-Union
episodes.overview: After Mr. Feeny crushes Cory's baseball dream, Cory's dad calls on pitcher Jim Abbott to provide some advice.

episodes.name: Santa's Little Helper
episodes.overview: Cory's well-intentioned gift for Shawn is less than well received.

episodes.name: The Father/Son Game
episodes.overview: Cory and Eric try to avoid attending a father-and-son softball game that their dad is looking forward to.

episodes.name: Once in Love With Amy
episodes.overview: It's a big affair to Cory and Eric when they discover dancing shoes in their mom's bowling bag.

episodes.name: She Loves Me, She Loves Me Not
episodes.overview: Cory's classmate Topanga develops a crush on Eric.

episodes.name: The B-Team of Life
episodes.overview: Cory is frustrated at being named to the basketball team's B-squad.

episodes.name: Model Family
episodes.overview: Eric takes a fall after a woman butters him up to think that he can quit his job and become a model.

episodes.name: Risky Business
episodes.overview: Cory and Shawn learn about the risks of investment when they bet on race horses for a school assignment.

episodes.name: The Fugitive
episodes.overview: Fearing his parents' wrath, Shawn hides out in Cory's bedroom after a prank goes awry.

episodes.name: It's a Wonderful Night
episodes.overview: Cory and Shawn find their plans thwarted when Mr. Feeny subs for their baby sitter.

episodes.name: Kid Gloves
episodes.overview: Cory gets Alan's boxing medallion as a birthday present--and promptly loses it while on a scuba-diving field trip.

episodes.name: The Play's the Thing
episodes.overview: In a decisive move, Cory quits the title role in a school presentation of Hamlet.

episodes.name: Boy Meets Girl
episodes.overview: Cory is frustrated when his best friend Shawn falls for a girl.

episodes.name: I Dream of Feeny
episodes.overview: Cory wishes that Mr. Feeny would get sick, but then feels guilty when the teacher ends up in the hospital.
